{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream trench coat, straight cut, knee length, #f5f0e6, cotton twill.
Wool-blend midi skirt, A-line silhouette, hem hitting mid-calf, #8b5a2b, heavy wool knit.
Fine-gauge turtleneck sweater, fitted ribbed body with a slightly dropped shoulder, charcoal heather, merino wool.
Brown leather ankle boots, slight heel block, #6f4e37, smooth calfskin.

This outfit is perfect for a nine-hour walking tour of the old city because the trench coat offers essential protection against the autumn cold while allowing full freedom of movement on cobblestone streets. The sturdy wool skirt and fitted knit top strike the right balance between warmth and comfort needed for extended standing and walking without feeling weighed down. Neutral earth tones harmonize beautifully with the historic architecture, ensuring she looks polished yet practical enough to navigate a full day outdoors."}
